description: This public Zenodo workbook gives technoeconomic assumptions for Indonesia energy-system modelling from 2015 to 2070. The producer lists investment, fixed and variable costs; plant lifetimes; efficiencies; emissions; capacity factors; demand; residual capacity; electricity output; and renewable supply and potential. Its structure was adapted for OSeMOSYS, and the metadata also mention FlexTool parameters. Record 14536072 lists a single Excel file under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a national planning dataset, not a measured hourly dispatch trace or a complete inventory of every local grid asset. Values drawn from several sources and projected across future decades carry temporal and source uncertainty that must be checked before running a particular scenario. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing technology and demand tables for long-term expansion or decarbonisation simulations. model-osemosys is related by the producer description, but no workbook import or reproduced optimisation was tested. Only the article and public repository metadata were read.
name: Indonesia energy-system technoeconomic assumptions, 2015–2070
